verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe Scheduled Tasks with cron schedules that let agents 'start and run autonomously in the background' (docs-2), plus related capabilities like scheduling messages to agents while away (docs-39), isolated background worktrees (docs-38), and headless/non-interactive CLI runs for CI automation (docs-50). This directly matches the story of autonomous background automations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that scheduled background tasks work reliably (community evidence focuses on other bugs/exfiltration issues, not scheduling specifically), and more detail on monitoring/error-handling for unattended runs.
